tickets.title: Coordinate divorce-related financial documents
tickets.text:
Use this checklist to coordinate divorce document requests:

- Confirm Mira Quillwhistle’s attorney Dana Wrenpuddle contact information and communication permissions.
- Identify required financial statements, tax returns, pay stubs, benefit statements, insurance policies, estate documents, and debt records.
- Check that requested documents cover the relevant lookback period without using fixed calendar deadlines in the template.
- Separate joint, individual, business, retirement, and trust-related documents.
- Verify whether any restricted stock, options, deferred compensation, or pension benefits need special documentation.
- Track missing items and responsible party for each document.
- Confirm secure delivery method before transmitting any sensitive materials.
- Save copies and notes to the appropriate client file location.
Assemble the requested account statements, tax returns, pay stubs, benefit statements, insurance pages, mortgage records, and equity compensation reports by 2024-12-06 for delivery to Dana Wrenpuddle.
tickets.evidence: by 2024-12-06, assemble Dana’s requested account statements, tax returns, pay stubs, benefit statements, insurance pages, mortgage records, and equity compensation reports

tickets.title: Prepare ownership inventory for divorce counsel
tickets.text: Prepare an inventory that distinguishes Mira Quillwhistle’s individual accounts, Simon Quillwhistle’s separate accounts, joint property and liabilities, beneficiary designations, and recurring household payments for counsel discussion of ownership changes before transfers.
tickets.evidence: by 2024-12-13, prepare an inventory distinguishing Mira’s individual accounts, Simon’s known separate accounts, joint property/liabilities, beneficiary designations, and recurring household payments for counsel discussion of ownership changes before transfers

tickets.title: Reconcile Cloudberry Kite Systems equity grants
tickets.text: Reconcile Mira Quillwhistle’s Cloudberry Kite Systems grant, vested and unvested share totals, withholding amounts, and sale history for legal review.
tickets.evidence: by 2024-12-10 reconcile grants, vested/unvested shares, withholding, and sale history for legal review
